verdict.rationale: Modal documents a dedicated 'Filesystem Access' guide for sandboxes (modal-docs-8), and the JS/Go SDK docs show mounting a Volume into a sandbox and reading a file from it via exec (modal-docs-20, modal-docs-21). The evidence never describes specific SDK methods for reading, writing, uploading, or downloading files, so the capability is only implied by a page title and an exec-based workaround. Missing for 10: explicit SDK file read/write API evidence, upload/download-specific methods, independent or hands-on corroboration.
